moments.title: Premier League Saturday Showdown
moments.blurb: Four Premier League matches are taking place today, Saturday 7th November, including Fulham vs Newcastle and Nottingham Forest vs Man City.

angles.name: Match Day Buzz
angles.copy: Big day for Premier League fans! Fulham host Newcastle, Forest take on Man City, plus Leeds vs Tottenham and Arsenal vs Hull. Who are you backing today?

angles.name: Local Team Focus
angles.copy: Huge one for the Toon Army today as Newcastle head to Fulham. Can they grab a crucial three points before the international break?

moments.title: Nations Championship Rugby
moments.blurb: The World Rugby Nations Championship continues today with Scotland vs New Zealand at Murrayfield and Wales vs Japan in Cardiff.

angles.name: Rugby Action Today
angles.copy: Massive day for rugby fans! Scotland take on the All Blacks at Murrayfield, while Wales face Japan in Cardiff. Who's watching?

angles.name: Wales Battle Japan
angles.copy: Pob lwc i Gymru! Wales are at home in Cardiff today, taking on Japan in the Nations Championship. Big game for the boys in red!

moments.title: Lorde Turns 30
moments.blurb: New Zealand singer-songwriter Lorde, born Ella Yelich-O'Connor, celebrates her 30th birthday today, 7th November.

angles.name: Happy 30th Lorde
angles.copy: Can you believe Lorde is 30 today?! From 'Royals' to 'Solar Power', she's given us some incredible tracks. What's your favourite?

angles.name: Lorde's Impact
angles.copy: Happy 30th to the one and only Lorde! A true trailblazer who changed the pop landscape. Here's to many more years of brilliant music.

moments.title: Joni Mitchell's 83rd Birthday
moments.blurb: The legendary Canadian singer-songwriter Joni Mitchell celebrates her 83rd birthday today, 7th November.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Joni
angles.copy: An icon turns 83! Happy Birthday to the incredible Joni Mitchell, whose music continues to inspire generations. What's your go-to Joni track?

angles.name: Timeless Talent
angles.copy: From 'Big Yellow Taxi' to 'A Case of You', Joni Mitchell's songwriting is simply unmatched. Wishing a very happy 83rd to a true legend.

moments.title: Adam Ant Turns 71
moments.blurb: New Wave icon Adam Ant, born Stuart Leslie Goddard, celebrates his 71st birthday today, 7th November.

angles.name: Prince Charming is 71!
angles.copy: Happy 71st Birthday to the one and only Adam Ant! Still looking dandy and making us want to 'Stand and Deliver'. What's your favourite Ant hit?

angles.name: Antmusic for a Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st to Adam Ant! The 'Prince Charming' of New Wave still has that unique spark. Celebrate with some classic Antmusic today!

moments.title: Alexandra Palace Fireworks Festival
moments.blurb: The Alexandra Palace Fireworks Festival continues tonight, Saturday 7th November, offering one of London's largest Bonfire Night celebrations.

angles.name: Ally Pally Fireworks!
angles.copy: The skies over London are lighting up tonight for Bonfire Night! Alexandra Palace's Fireworks Festival is on – don't miss the spectacular display.

angles.name: Last Chance for Fireworks
angles.copy: Still got that Bonfire Night feeling? Alexandra Palace is the place to be tonight for fireworks, food, and fun. Wrap up warm and enjoy the show!

moments.title: Strictly's Jaime Winstone Out
moments.blurb: Actress Jaime Winstone will miss this weekend's Strictly Come Dancing live show due to a torn abdominal muscle, but will receive a bye to next week.

angles.name: Strictly Injury Drama
angles.copy: Oh no! Strictly's Jaime Winstone is out this weekend with an injury. Wishing her a speedy recovery – who do you think will shine on the dance floor in her absence?

angles.name: Glitterball Race Heats Up
angles.copy: Another twist in the Strictly ballroom! Jaime Winstone won't be dancing this weekend. It's anyone's game for the Glitterball trophy now!

moments.title: England Rugby vs Australia
moments.blurb: England will face Australia in their first home game of the Nations Championship tomorrow, Sunday 8th November, at Twickenham Stadium.

angles.name: Red Rose vs Wallabies
angles.copy: Tomorrow, England take on Australia in a massive Nations Championship clash at Twickenham! Who are you backing to win this historic rivalry?

angles.name: Sunday Rugby Thriller
angles.copy: Get ready for some Sunday rugby action! England vs Australia promises to be a thrilling encounter. What's your score prediction?

moments.title: Oxford Street Christmas Lights Switch-On
moments.blurb: Oxford Street's Christmas lights, featuring a Harry Potter-themed takeover, are set to switch on Monday 9th November with a 'magical' night of entertainment.

angles.name: Magic on Oxford Street
angles.copy: Get ready for some festive magic! Oxford Street's Harry Potter-themed Christmas lights switch on this Monday. Who's excited for the wizarding world to light up London?

angles.name: Christmas Countdown
angles.copy: The Christmas countdown officially begins on Oxford Street this Monday! Expect a spellbinding Harry Potter takeover for this year's lights switch-on.

moments.title: Madame Blanc Mysteries Returns
moments.blurb: The Madame Blanc Mysteries returns for its fifth season on Monday 9th November, exclusively on Acorn TV, with new episodes weekly.

angles.name: Cozy Mystery Fix
angles.copy: Your favourite antique dealer/murder solver is back! The Madame Blanc Mysteries Season 5 premieres Monday on Acorn TV. Ready for more French intrigue?

angles.name: New Series Alert
angles.copy: Sally Lindsay returns for new mysteries in Sainte Victoire! Don't miss the Season 5 premiere of The Madame Blanc Mysteries this Monday.

moments.title: Diana Krall Turns 62
moments.blurb: Canadian jazz pianist and singer Diana Krall celebrates her 62nd birthday on Wednesday 11th November.

angles.name: Jazz Queen's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 62nd Birthday to the sublime Diana Krall on Wednesday! Her smooth vocals and incredible piano skills are simply timeless.

angles.name: Celebrating a Jazz Icon
angles.copy: Wednesday marks Diana Krall's 62nd birthday. What's your favourite track from the multi-Grammy winning jazz sensation?

moments.title: EFG London Jazz Festival Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The EFG London Jazz Festival begins on Friday 13th November, running for ten days across various venues in the city, featuring over 300 live shows.

angles.name: Jazz Takes Over London
angles.copy: Get ready for a city filled with rhythm! The EFG London Jazz Festival starts this Friday, bringing ten days of incredible music to venues across the capital. What gigs are you eyeing up?

angles.name: Weekend of Smooth Sounds
angles.copy: The EFG London Jazz Festival kicks off this weekend! Whether you're a seasoned jazz fan or curious to explore, there's something for everyone. Dive into the smooth sounds of London.

moments.title: Noah Kahan Plays London
moments.blurb: American singer-songwriter Noah Kahan is set to play multiple dates in London on 13th, 14th, and 17th November.

angles.name: Noah Kahan Hits London
angles.copy: Calling all 'Stick Season' fans! Noah Kahan is in London this weekend for multiple sold-out shows. Who's lucky enough to have tickets?

angles.name: Folk-Pop Sensation
angles.copy: Noah Kahan bringing his unique folk-pop sound to London this week! Expect heartfelt lyrics and incredible live energy. Are you ready?

moments.title: Wales Face All Blacks
moments.blurb: Wales will play New Zealand in the Nations Championship on Saturday 14th November at Principality Stadium, Cardiff.

angles.name: Big Game for Wales
angles.copy: Another huge test for Wales next Saturday as they welcome the mighty All Blacks to the Principality Stadium! Can they cause an upset?

angles.name: All Blacks in Cardiff
angles.copy: The All Blacks are coming to Cardiff! Wales vs New Zealand next Saturday is going to be an absolute cracker. Get behind the boys!

moments.title: I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! Launch
moments.blurb: I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! officially launches on Monday 16th November at 9pm on ITV1, delayed by one day due to the UEFA Nations League match.

angles.name: Jungle Countdown
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! starts a week on Monday. Who are you hoping to see in the jungle this year?

angles.name: Ant & Dec Are Back!
angles.copy: Get ready for trials, tantrums, and Ant & Dec's hilarious commentary! I'm A Celeb returns next Monday. Who's your dream campmate?

moments.title: New BBC Drama 'Honey' Premieres
moments.blurb: The new Cold War spy drama 'Honey' premieres on BBC One and BBC iPlayer on Saturday 14th November.

angles.name: New Spy Thriller
angles.copy: Looking for your next TV obsession? New Cold War spy drama 'Honey' lands on BBC One next Saturday. Get ready for some serious espionage!

angles.name: Weekend Viewing
angles.copy: Mark your calendars! The highly anticipated new drama 'Honey' starts next Saturday on BBC. Perfect for a gripping weekend watch.

moments.title: Travis Barker Turns 51
moments.blurb: Blink-182 drummer Travis Barker celebrates his 51st birthday on Saturday 14th November.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Travis
angles.copy: Happy 51st Birthday to the legendary Travis Barker! The powerhouse behind Blink-182, still drumming up a storm. What's your favourite Blink track?

angles.name: Drummer Extraordinaire
angles.copy: From punk rock anthems to pop collaborations, Travis Barker is a drumming icon. Wishing him a very happy 51st next Saturday!
